skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: W Dali
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/W Dali. Młynar's attire as a knight-errant, wandering Kazimierz's plains and endless forests, the words engraved on the hilt of his sword not yet covered by useless trinkets.
skins.quote: He has spent a long time searching, yet is still where he started. The night before news arrived of a Nearl family swordstaff entering Leithanien, he could not help seeing some long-lost silhouettes through the torrential rain.

skins.name: Roar Against the Wilds
skins.content: Iteration Provident/Roar Against the Wilds. Młynar's iteration from decision point F/3019226. The Black Riders have finally arrived at the Forgotten Plains, but the Hermit Knight chooses not to leave. Instead, he bars the way, alone.
skins.quote: 'If you wish to go, they cannot stop you, but you wouldn't be able to live with yourself, would you? You cannot sit idly by while darkness becomes the master of all. So go, show them how a spear forged of light shall never break.'
